title: The Dramatic Inferno Sub 50 Zuk (OSRS)

claims.text: Gnomonkey completed a sub-50-minute Inferno, which he says came after a month of struggling to get it.
Gnomonkey says the finish against Zuk was the most dramatic possible finish, which was not what he wanted but is how it worked out.
